title: Rob the Guard First
setup: Your rook on g7 stands between your bishop and Black's king, so any rook move gives check. Pick the one Black cannot answer with a capture.
hint: A discovered check can be answered by capturing the piece that gives it. Find what can take your bishop, and make that impossible.
explanation:
## The Idea

Every rook move checks. Most let the knight on d7 take the bishop on f6, and the two double checks, on g8 and h7, hand the king your rook. {{Rxd7+}} takes that knight instead, so the check stands and {{Kg8}} is the only legal move.

The rook on d7 now looks along the seventh rank at the queen, and the queen has no time to escape: {{Rxb7}} takes it. The rook checked, and robbed twice.
